categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of high-performance quartz glass materials and products, including quartz glass fibers and composite materials. Its main business segments cover quartz glass ingots, tubes, rods, plates, quartz glass devices, quartz glass fiber products, and composite materials based on quartz glass fibers. These products serve key industries such as semiconductors, aerospace, optics, photovoltaics, and optical communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in gas-melted quartz glass, synthetic quartz glass, electric-melted quartz glass, and quartz glass fiber manufacturing. It has developed proprietary technologies for low-expansion synthetic quartz glass, high-uniformity synthetic quartz, low-hydroxyl and chlorine-free synthetic quartz, and electronic-grade quartz fibers. Production methods include batch processing, precision machining, 2.5D and 3D weaving of quartz glass fiber fabrics, and composite material fabrication, supported by a comprehensive R&D platform including national and provincial technology centers and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the semiconductor manufacturing sector, aerospace industry, precision optics, photovoltaic industry, and optical communications. The company supplies critical quartz glass materials and components used in semiconductor chip processing equipment, aerospace functional materials, optical lenses and photomasks, photovoltaic production consumables, and optical fiber preform manufacturing. Major customers include international semiconductor equipment manufacturers and leading domestic high-tech enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in domestic markets accounting for approximately 68% of revenue, and international markets making up about 32%. It has subsidiaries and production facilities in multiple Chinese provinces including Hubei, Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu, and Shandong. Export activities involve foreign currency transactions mainly in USD, JPY, EUR, and TWD.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Feilihua occupies an upstream to midstream position in the quartz glass supply chain, producing raw quartz glass materials, intermediate products, and finished quartz glass components. It integrates vertically by extending into quartz glass fiber production and composite materials, providing one-stop solutions for downstream high-tech industries such as semiconductor equipment manufacturers and aerospace component producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with strategic R&D investments focused on key materials for semiconductors, aerospace, optics, photovoltaics, and optical communications. R&D priorities include developing low-expansion quartz glass, high-purity synthetic quartz sand, chlorine-free quartz glass, and advanced quartz fiber composites. It aims to enhance product performance, expand production capacity, and accelerate domestic substitution of imported materials, supported by collaborations with research institutes and continuous talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of quartz glass materials, quartz glass products, quartz glass fibers, and composite materials. The company operates a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders based on production capacity and inventory. It also derives income from technology development, licensing, and government subsidies related to innovation projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier and one of the few global manufacturers with mass production capabilities in quartz glass fibers. It holds a dominant position in the Chinese aerospace quartz fiber market and is recognized as a key supplier to major semiconductor equipment manufacturers. Competitors include other domestic and international quartz glass producers, but Feilihua differentiates itself through integrated production, advanced technology, and strategic industry partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.74 billion, a 16.68% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 314 million, down 41.56%. Total assets reached about RMB 6.09 billion, with net assets of RMB 4.13 billion. Despite short-term market fluctuations, the company maintains steady cash flow and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures increasing nearly 12% to RMB 250 million, reflecting a focus on long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hubei Feilihua offers high-performance, high-purity quartz glass materials and products tailored for critical high-tech industries, emphasizing product quality, technological innovation, and comprehensive industry chain integration. Its unique value lies in providing customized, cost-effective solutions with stable quality and timely delivery, supported by a full spectrum of quartz glass and fiber products. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and certifications from leading semiconductor equipment manufacturers enhance its competitive edge and customer trust.
